text:
emma-billing: Heads up — PineBridge (PB-210) invoice INV-8012 failed on card charge. Gateway response `do_not_honor`. last4 3110. Tried 2x.

ryan-finance: thanks. is AVS/CVC ok? if it's soft decline we can retry once, if it's hard (do_not_honor often is) escalate to customer for new method.

emma-billing: AVS matched, CVC passed. Gateway flagged as `do_not_honor` with decline id `d_9b3c2`.

priya-cs: pinging PineBridge now with two options: quick card update link or wire/ACH. asking which they prefer and how fast they can move.

maya-ops: if they pick ACH, recommend micro-deposits for verification (two small amounts) OR immediate wire. note on bank delays: micro-deposits usually show in 1-3 business days. wire is same-day if they send before bank cutoff.

priya-cs: customer answered — their billing team says ACH is preferred but they need it verified today for payroll reconciliation. they asked if we can do instant account verification (plaid) or accept a one-time expedited ACH.

ryan-finance: we don't have instant ACH for all customers. we can offer: 1) card update via secure link (fastest), 2) same-day wire with beneficiary confirmation, 3) ACH micro-deposit (1-3 days) or 4) third-party instantaneous verification if they provide token (rare). Tell them fastest is card or wire.

emma-billing: sending secure card link + wire template. cc @ryan-finance. Also scheduling one auto-retry in 90 minutes per policy.

ops-bot: Auto-retry scheduled for INV-8012 at 1910511589 (90 minutes).

maya-ops: Wire template to include exact legal name and account type. here's a cleaned template to paste: ```Wire instructions: Bank: Central Trust Bank
SWIFT: CTBKUS44
Routing (ACH): 021000021
Account name: [Customer legal entity EXACT]
Account number: [masked — show last 4 only]
Account type: Checking
Reference: INV-8012 / Redwood Inference```

ryan-finance: also request a short signed email from their billing contact confirming the account name. last wire we had got rejected because payment was to parent company name.

priya-cs: PineBridge replied — they can do a same-day wire but need our bank's intermediary details for international routing. pinging ops for any intermediary SWIFT/FFIs.

maya-ops: we normally provide just our SWIFT and beneficiary. for international we sometimes need an intermediary bank. i'll pull the routing sheet and DM it to you. when sending account numbers in email, always mask like `****4321` and include a checksum line to prevent copy errors.

ryan-finance: if they insist on ACH and can't wait, offer to hold invoice in "pending-wire" status and waive late fee if they confirm wire intent and send proof of initiation. Maria (revenue ops) signs fee waivers.

priya-cs: noted — will ask for proof of initiation and loop Maria if needed.

emma-billing: logged decline id `d_9b3c2` and scheduled retry id `r_1910511589` in invoice notes. adding a follow-up reminder for 48 hours if unresolved.

priya-cs: customer says they'll initiate wire today and send the receipt. I'll attach once received and escalate fee-waiver to Maria if bank delays.

ryan-finance: perfect. mark as "awaiting proof of payment". thanks team. :thumbsup:
